top_choice_rationale: P001 recognizes a mature, durable macroeconomic insight: collateral-constrained balance sheets link asset values, borrowing capacity, and aggregate amplification. Kiyotaki, Moore, and Gertler have central claims to its closely related core formulations, provided the citation remains confined to collateral constraints and financial amplification rather than all credit-friction macroeconomics.
recusal_note: I have a long-running collaboration with Peter J. Klenow, but he is not credited in any proposal on this slate; no candidate-specific conflict is apparent for P001 or the other listed proposals.
